data.title: Ellington Financial Announces Upsizing and Pricing of Additional 7.375% Senior Unsecured Notes Due 2030
data.description: In Old Greenwich, Connecticut, Ellington Financial Inc. (NYSE: EFC) revealed the pricing of its upsized offering of 7.375% senior unsecured notes due 2030. Originally set at $100 million, the offering increased to $150 million in total principal amount. The New Notes will be issued through specific subsidiaries, acting as the Issuers. These notes, which will be the responsibility of the Issuers, are guaranteed in full and unconditionally by the Company.

data.title: Curbline Properties Announces Third Quarter 2026 Investment Update
data.description: In New York, Curbline Properties Corp. (NYSE: CURB), a company specializing in ownership of convenience centers in affluent suburban areas, revealed its investment activity for the third quarter and full year 2026. The company noted a continued high level of investment opportunities in the third quarter, following trends from earlier in the year, as it aims to expand as the first publicly traded real estate firm concentrating on convenience properties. Curbline is optimistic about the growth potential of these properties.

data.title: Julie K. Streich Joins Apogee Enterprises’ Board of Directors
data.description: A prominent provider of architectural building products and high-performance coated materials, Apogee Enterprises, Inc. (Nasdaq: APOG), based in Minneapolis, has announced the election of Julie K. Streich as an independent director. Streich has been appointed to the Audit Committee of the Board from September 11, 2026, following a rigorous search process. Mark Pom, Chairman of the Board, expressed enthusiasm about Streich's appointment, highlighting her valuable addition to the team.

data.title: BrightSpire Capital Announces $0.16 Per Share Dividend for Third Quarter 2026
data.description: In New York, BrightSpire Capital, Inc. (NYSE: BRSP) declared a dividend of $0.16 per share of Class A common stock for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The dividend will be paid on October 14, 2026, to stockholders of record as of September 30, 2026. BrightSpire Capital, Inc. (NYSE: BRSP) is an internally managed company and one of the leading publicly traded firms.

data.title: DHT Holdings, Inc. secures three-year time charter for DHT Panther
data.description: In Hamilton, Bermuda on September 14, 2026, DHT Holdings, Inc. disclosed that they have secured a three-year time charter agreement for the VLCC DHT Panther, which was constructed in 2016. The deal, signed with a worldwide energy corporation, will see the vessel being chartered at a rate of $100,000 per day. The contract is set to initiate in October 2026, providing a lucrative opportunity for DHT with this sizeable agreement.

data.title: Crown Castle Announces CFO Retirement and COO Transition; Names Kris Hinson as Next CFO
data.description: Crown Castle Inc. (NYSE: CCI) disclosed that Sunit Patel will retire as EVP and CFO on March 31, 2027, post the filing of the 2026 Form 10-K. Starting April 1, 2027, Kris Hinson, the current EVP and Chief Commercial Officer, will take over as CFO. Cathy Piche, the EVP and COO, will leave Crown Castle, stepping down from her role on September 23, 2026. She will aid in transitioning her responsibilities until February 22, 2027, serving as a special advisor. The company is actively searching for her successor as COO.

data.title: Kite Realty Group Upgraded by Fitch to BBB+ with Stable Outlook
data.description: Today, Kite Realty Group (NYSE: KRG) based in Indianapolis disclosed an improvement in its Long-Term Issuer Default Ratings by Fitch Ratings ("Fitch"). The upgrade affects both the Company and its operating partnership, Kite Realty Group, L.P. collectively known as "KRG", which have been raised to BBB+ from BBB. The Rating Outlook accompanying this upgrade is noted as Stable.

data.title: Trump supports flock surveillance cameras despite Senate investigation and opposition from Bernie Sanders; bill pledged.
data.description: During a recent flight on Air Force One, the President endorsed the use of AI-powered license plate readers, despite the controversy surrounding them. These devices have sparked a Senate investigation and a proposed bill from Bernie Sanders.

data.title: Richard Parry Joins Board of Directors of Bimini Capital Management
data.description: In Vero Beach, Florida, on September 14, 2026, Bimini Capital Management, Inc. (OTCQX: BMNM) announced the appointment of Richard Parry to its board of directors as a Class II director until 2029. Parry, currently serving as the President and Chief Investment Officer of Tom Johnson Investment Management, LLC, a company 80% owned by Bimini Capital following this year's acquisition, also has a retained equity interest in TJIM through a related trust. As part of the acquisition deal, Mr. Parry has entered into an employment agreement with TJIM.

data.title: Yatra Issues Statement in Response to Magna’s Amendment and Extension of Its Unsolicited Tender Offer
data.description: The Yatra board has unanimously advised shareholders of Yatra not to submit their shares into the offer proposed by Magna. The decision was reached collectively and urges investors to refrain from participating in Magna's bid.

data.title: Orchid Island Capital Announces September 2026 Monthly Dividend and August 31, 2026 RMBS Portfolio Characteristics
data.description: Orchid Island Capital, Inc. based in Vero Beach, Florida, declared a monthly cash dividend of $0.10 per share for September 2026. The dividend will be distributed on October 29, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 30, 2026. The ex-dividend date is also September 30, 2026. The company's Board of Directors intends to reveal details of the next common stock dividend on October 14, 2026.

data.title: Quantum Appoints Mike Heuer as Chief Information Officer
data.description: Today, Quantum Corporation (Nasdaq: QMCO) based in Centennial, Colorado, has appointed Mike Heuer as its new Chief Information Officer. This announcement comes as Heuer steps into the role, where he will oversee Quantum's worldwide information technology division. He will be responsible for managing enterprise applications, data operations, AI implementation, IT infrastructure, and cybersecurity measures. Hugues Meyrath, the President and CEO of Quantum, expressed confidence in Heuer's capabilities, citing his track record of merging technology strategies with corporate goals and driving large-scale transformations within organizations.

data.title: Pega Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend for Fourth Quarter of 2026
data.description: In Waltham, Massachusetts, Pegasystems Inc. (NASDAQ: PEGA) has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.03 per share, consistent with its current dividend program. The dividend for Q4 2026 is scheduled to be disbursed on October 15, 2026, to shareholders recorded as of October 1, 2026. Pega is an enterprise AI software company known for providing solutions that optimize critical business operations. Their platform integrates AI technology to redefine and streamline complex enterprise processes and decision-making.

data.title: Asia Pacific Wire & Cable Corporation Limited Announces Results of 2026 Annual General Meeting and Corporate Updates
data.description: Asia Pacific Wire & Cable Corporation Limited, a company listed on NASDAQ under the ticker symbol APWC, disclosed that all proposed resolutions at its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on September 11, 2026, in Taipei, Taiwan, have received shareholder approval. This marks a significant milestone for the company as it continues to drive its operations and strategy forward.
